prior_R003_relationship.old_geometry_information: R003 already stores site directional second-moment eigenvalue means/std. Legendre l2 geometry power is a function of that second moment, not a new physical information type.
prior_R003_relationship.same_weight_identity: For normalized geometric second-moment eigenvalues lambda1..3: Q2(site)=(3*sum(lambda_j^2)-1)/2. With identical neighbor weights, mean(Q2)=(3*sum(mean(lambda_j)^2+std(lambda_j)^2)-1)/2.
prior_R003_relationship.actual_weight_difference: Old R003 uses exp(-covalent_ratio^2)*(1-distance/6)^2 with distance<6. LINEGRAPH24 uses exp(-covalent_ratio^2) on supplied periodic6A edges and geometric weight-sum normalization. This reweighting alone does not establish new information.
prior_R003_relationship.l1_relationship: Geometric l1 is a normalized directional dipole norm; dipoles and directional tensor ideas also exist in prior chemical representation programs. Keep it as a geometric control.

chemical_angular_provenance.en_ratio: Signed dimensionless EN contrast with explicit missing-EN masking, geometric rather than chemical-amplitude normalization; joint angular power l1/l2/l3.
chemical_angular_provenance.radius_ratio: Signed covalent-radius contrast and its angular power l1/l2/l3.
chemical_angular_provenance.unlike_element: Element-identity heterobond indicator and its angular power l1/l2/l3.
chemical_angular_provenance.interpretation: These18 columns encode chemistry-conditioned angular arrangement. Some moment types overlap previous programs; the block is not claimed to contain18 independent new physical facts.

numerical_novelty_limit: 24 columns are nonconstant, not affine scalar duplicates and outside the old258-column linear span on these2164 inputs. These numerical tests do not exclude arbitrary nonlinear recoverability, prove new information, or establish target accuracy benefit.
effect_evaluation: The frozen StageA Cat90-direct versus Cat66-direct comparison determines incremental predictive utility; no accuracy result was used in this design.
